notes: Shady Grove version: mirrors the College Park Accounting plan (acct-major); the requirements are identical, so the same plan is used. Its official flag and placeholder notes carry over below.

No Accounting-specific 4-year plan was reachable from the fetched source (the catalog's 'Catalog four-year plan' section only links to the Smith School's general roadmaps page and 4yearplans.umd.edu; the college's own general BS 'Typical Program' table stops after the sophomore year with no Accounting-specific courses placed). This plan is CONSTRUCTED from the catalog's own College Requirements and Accounting-major requirement tables; flagged in docs/project/owner-review.md. Gen Ed slots are left out: only the major is audited.

Calculus gateway filled with MATH140 (Calculus I); Business Statistics gateway filled with BMGT230 (Business Statistics); Oral Communication filled with COMM107 (Oral Communication: Principles and Practices) -- all named directly in the catalog's own option lists, not invented.

Track choice: Public Accounting Track (BMGT311, BMGT323, BMGT411, BMGT422 fixed, plus one of six named electives). The one-of-six elective slot is filled with BMGT313 (Financial Statement Analysis), a real course named directly in that slot's own catalog list.

Course placement (year/term) is constructed, not sourced from a published plan: BMGT220/BMGT221 (Principles of Accounting I/II) placed sophomore year matching the college's own Freshman-Sophomore School Requirements grouping; BMGT310/321/326 (the major's own 9-credit core) and the Public Accounting Track courses placed junior/senior year, after their Freshman-Sophomore prerequisites-in-spirit, since the source gives no term-by-term sequencing for them.
